name: Infantry_Claude
author: Infantry AI
description: The Claude Code harness (HARNESS H7b-2/3): launches claude (-p stream-json, or the persistent --input-format stream-json), reads its event stream, maps tool approval to permission modes, routes its tool calls through the watched runner, lists its models, and reads its session store and plan limits. Setting liveIdleMinutes (harness.claude.liveIdleMinutes, default 0 = never): minutes a resting live claude process may idle before it is stopped; each live process holds about 150-400 MB of RAM while it exists, so lower it to reclaim memory from sessions nobody wakes (the next wake resumes).
